transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net customer installations, my name is Edward. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Edward. I am absolutely furious! An Openreach fiber engineer was booked to install our full fibre broadband today between one and six, and nobody showed up for the second time in two weeks! I took two full days of unpaid annual leave from my nursing job to sit in an empty hallway waiting!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand how infuriating that is, Ella, especially taking unpaid time off work twice for missed engineer appointments. Let me access the regional engineering dispatch system immediately.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Edward, because losing two days of nursing pay is over two hundred pounds out of my pocket.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before we pull up the dispatch logs, could you please verify your installation address and your four-digit security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, the address is 17 Oakfield Terrace, Chester, CH1 4NP, my mobile contact number is zero seven seven zero zero, nine zero zero six eight two, and the security PIN is 4490.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for verifying those details, Ella. I have your fiber order and Openreach order reference open on our screen.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Great, thanks.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So just to confirm the timeline: you had an initial installation slot booked on Tuesday the seventh that was missed, and today's rescheduled slot for this afternoon was also missed without any notification call. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, exactly that. Both times I received a text message at eight in the morning confirming the engineer was on schedule, and then nobody turned up.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Did the regional contractor send an automated text message or card through your letterbox claiming customer not home?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, absolutely nothing. No card, no text, no phone call. I was sitting right by the front door with the window open all afternoon.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Are the external telegraph poles and street distribution cabinets easily accessible from your front driveway?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The telegraph pole is literally situated on the pavement right outside our front garden boundary hedge with clear line of sight.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me query the Openreach contractor portal for the field technician's status notes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Are you still with me on the line, Edward?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes Ella, apologies. The technician's dispatch terminal updated thirty minutes ago with the note: 'Job rolled over due to prior site civil blockage'.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So the engineer knew he wasn't coming thirty minutes ago and didn't even bother to ring me?! That shows complete contempt for customers waiting at home!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Field engineering technicians are instructed to update their mobile dispatch app, which feeds into our automated communication queue. If the technician encounters severe duct blockages on an earlier job, safety rules require them to remain on site until civil contractors arrive.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Well your automated communication queue failed completely because I was left waiting like an idiot for five hours in an unheated front hallway!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Under the Ofcom Automatic Compensation Scheme, you are legally entitled to twenty-nine pounds and fifteen pence for each missed appointment without needing to file a claim.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Twenty-nine pounds doesn't cover my lost nursing salary, but at least it acknowledges the service failure.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have already credited fifty-eight pounds and thirty pence to your billing account covering both missed appointment slots, which will appear on your next statement.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: When can an engineer actually come out and connect our optical fiber line so we can get online?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me check the priority expedited escalation calendar with the Openreach regional operations desk.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello, Edward, did the line freeze?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes Ella, apologies for the pause. The earliest priority escalation slot available is this coming Thursday between eight in the morning and one in the afternoon.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thursday morning? That means taking a third morning off work, which puts my hospital shift rotation in jeopardy!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can designate this appointment as a 'Senior Technical Specialist Guaranteed First Call', meaning the technician arrives at your property between eight and eight-thirty before attending any other customer jobs.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: If they arrive at eight, my husband can let them into the house before he leaves for his shift.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have tagged the work order with 'Customer Vulnerable Escalation' so the regional field manager must personally track the engineer's arrival on their GPS monitor.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will hopefully prevent a third no-show.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: In the interim, I will arrange an emergency 5G mobile Wi-Fi dongle to be couriered to your address tomorrow morning free of charge.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Having an emergency 5G dongle will allow my teenage children to complete their secondary school homework.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The 5G dongle includes unlimited high-speed data and does not require any line installation.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will it arrive by Royal Mail or DPD courier?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It will be delivered by DPD tracked courier before eleven tomorrow morning with a one-hour SMS delivery window.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is very fast delivery, thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to confirm what you mentioned earlier, Ella, your contact telephone number is zero seven seven zero zero, nine zero zero six eight two?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, zero seven seven zero zero, nine zero zero six eight two.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have linked that mobile number for direct DPD driver updates.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That way my husband can monitor the parcel delivery while I am on the ward.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Will the engineer require access to your attic or only the ground floor hallway for the optical ONT installation?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Only the ground floor hallway right next to the front door where our existing master socket is situated.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That will keep the internal cabling work straightforward for the technician.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What happens if Openreach fails to attend for a third consecutive time on Thursday?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If a third appointment is missed, our executive relations team handles the case and compensation increases automatically.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I don't care about compensation! I need working internet for my family! If an engineer doesn't show up on Thursday morning to connect that cable, I will literally throw your equipment onto the street, cancel the direct debit, and cancel the entire broadband contract!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Contract cancellations within the minimum term incur early termination charges calculated at thirty pounds per remaining month on the twenty-four month contract term.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Are you seriously threatening me with six hundred pounds of cancellation penalties after your third-party contractors failed twice to even show their faces?! That is utterly outrageous and abusive customer treatment!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am stating our contractual terms regarding premature termination, Ella.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: You have completely ruined what was otherwise helpful troubleshooting.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The appointment is confirmed for Thursday at eight in the morning under work order OR-99210-C.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let me note that work order... OR-99210-C.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The 5G backup dongle tracking number will be texted to your mobile this evening.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, I will look out for that text.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The broadband package itself is Gigafast 500, delivering five hundred megabits down once connected.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Our neighbors on Gigafast 500 say the optical line speed is very good when it is actually running.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, the fiber infrastructure delivers full symmetrical gigabit speeds.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I just hope the physical cable finally gets connected on Thursday.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The booking is locked in our database.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Wait, Edward, does the engineer need our original master socket reference number?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: He has all property records on his handheld terminal. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.
